title: How can we help?
intro: Find answers to common questions below. Can't find what you need? Email us — we read every message.

search.label: Search help
search.none: No questions match your search. Email us at <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email> and we'll help.

free.a: Yes. Browsing vendors and sending inquiries is free. To send an inquiry you'll need a free host account.

find.a: Go to <vendors>Vendors</vendors> in the top menu. You can search by service, location and event date, browse by category or city, and sort the results. Explore shows photos and videos from vendors. You don't need an account to browse.

contact.q: How do I contact a vendor?
contact.a: Open the vendor's page and choose Send Inquiry (Inquire in the app). Add your event date and a few details, then send. If you're not signed in, you'll be asked to log in or create a free host account first.

message.q: How do I message a vendor after sending an inquiry?
message.a: Open Inbox (in the website's menu, or the Inbox tab in the app) and choose the inquiry. Your whole conversation with the vendor is there. When they reply, you'll get a notification, and an email if you haven't read the reply yet. You can turn those emails off in Settings → Notifications.

payment_info.a: No. Vendora doesn't process payments between hosts and vendors. You arrange payment, deposits and any refunds directly with your vendor.

problem.q: What happens if I have a problem with a vendor?
problem.a: Start by contacting the vendor. Prices, deposits, cancellations and refunds are agreed between you and the vendor, and Vendora isn't part of that agreement. If a vendor seems fraudulent or breaks our rules, use Report this profile on their page or email us at <email>hello@eventvendora.com</email>. See our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> for details.

free.q: Is it free to list my business?
free.a: Yes. The Free plan includes one listing at no cost. Pro and Premium are optional monthly plans. <signup>Sign up as a vendor</signup> to get started.

commission.a: No. Vendora takes no commission on your bookings. Hosts pay you directly.

approval.q: How long does listing approval take?
approval.a: Our team reviews every new listing before it goes live, usually within 2–3 business days. We'll email you when it's approved.

inquiries.a: Hosts send you an inquiry from your listing page. It appears in your Inbox (in the website's menu, or the Inbox tab in the vendor app), and you'll get a notification. Reply there to keep the conversation going.

pause.a: Yes. On the website, go to My Profile, open the listing and choose Pause listing. In the vendor app, tap the pause button on the listing's card in Profile. While it's paused, your listing is hidden from browsing and search, and its page shows you're taking a break. Your conversations, calendar and reviews stay as they are. Resume whenever you're ready.

downgrade.q: What happens to my listings if I change or downgrade my plan?
downgrade.a: Nothing is deleted. Your existing listings and photos stay as they are. On a smaller plan you just can't add more than that plan allows. For what you're charged, see "What happens if I upgrade or downgrade?" under Billing.

blocked_title.q: Do hosts see the title of a blocked calendar date?
blocked_title.a: No. Hosts only see that the day is unavailable. The title is just for you.

photos.q: Why are my photos taking a while to upload?
photos.a: Large photos are resized before they upload, so a big batch can take a little while. On the website each photo can be up to 10 MB, with up to 100 per listing. iPhone HEIC photos aren't supported yet, so convert them to JPEG first. If an upload seems stuck for more than a minute, check your connection, refresh the page and try again.

card.q: How do I update my payment method?
card.a: Go to Subscription (under More in the menu), then Billing → Payment method → Update. This opens Stripe's secure page, where you can change your card.

invoice.q: How do I view or download my Vendora invoice or receipt?
invoice.a: Go to Subscription → Billing → Invoices. Choose View to open an invoice, or PDF to download it. These are the invoices for your own Vendora plan.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Go to Subscription → Billing → Cancel plan. This opens Stripe's secure billing page, where you confirm the cancellation. On iPhone, manage your plan on the website.

after_cancel.a: Your plan won't renew and you won't be charged again. You keep paid access until the end of the current billing period, and then your account moves to the Free plan. Canceling doesn't delete your account, listings or photos.

delete.q: What happens if I delete my account while subscribed?
delete.a: Deleting your account isn't the same as canceling. When you delete your account (Settings → Delete account), any active subscription is canceled immediately, and your account is deleted only once that cancellation goes through. You won't be charged again, your access ends when the account is deleted, and there's no refund for the unused part of the current billing period. To stop paying but keep your account, cancel your plan instead.

switch.q: What happens if I upgrade or downgrade?
switch.a: Switching between Pro and Premium takes effect right away. You're charged the new plan's monthly price that day, and a new billing month starts. Unused time on your old plan isn't refunded. Before you confirm, the Subscription page shows what you'll be charged. To move to Free, cancel your plan.
